entities.summary: Corentin Moutet is a French professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 31 achieved on 3 November 2025 and a doubles ranking of No. 347 achieved on 2 March 2026. He is currently the No. 3 singles player from France.
